about: The initial support class, by id, of the people only the expansions place outdoors (Solstheim; Mournhold's districts presented as exterior cells; the expansions' people in Vvardenfell), measured from the game data with the expansions selected (tools/actor_grounding_census.py --write). Read by tools/actor_grounding_layers.py for an id config/actor_grounding.json does not name, so that file does not move when an expansion's people are added. ground_npcs: standing on the ground or on a placed object; exceptions: as in the policy. No positions or heights.
